info.title: Transactions API
info.description:
## Sprint 4 — Transactions, Purchases, Exchanges & Notifications

This collection covers all user-facing transactional domains implemented in the Badelha backend. All routes are authenticated via `src/routes/index.js` and the individual route files — not the obsolete mock handlers in `src/app.js`.

### Authentication
All requests send `Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}`. Obtain a token via the **Sprint 1 – Authentication** collection and store it in the active environment's `accessToken` variable.

### Collection Variables
| Variable | Default | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `targetUserId` | `2` | Target user ID for create purchase/exchange requests |
| `productId` | `1` | Product ID for create purchase requests |
| `offeredPrice` | `100` | Offered price for create purchase requests |
| `initiatorProductId` | `1` | Your product ID for create exchange requests |
| `targetProductId` | `2` | Target product ID for create exchange requests |
| `purchaseId` | `1` | ID used in single-purchase requests (auto-captured) |
| `exchangeId` | `1` | ID used in single-exchange requests (auto-captured) |
| `notificationId` | `1` | ID used in single-notification requests (auto-captured) |
| `page` | `1` | Default page number for paginated endpoints |
| `limit` | `20` | Default page size for paginated endpoints |

### Folders
| Folder | Endpoints |
| --- | --- |
| Purchase Requests | POST /api/purchases, GET /api/purchases, GET /api/purchases/:id, PATCH /api/purchases/:id/accept, PATCH /api/purchases/:id/reject, PATCH /api/purchases/:id/complete, PATCH /api/purchases/:id/cancel |
| Exchange Requests | POST /api/exchanges, GET /api/exchanges, GET /api/exchanges/:id, PATCH /api/exchanges/:id/accept, PATCH /api/exchanges/:id/reject, PATCH /api/exchanges/:id/complete, PATCH /api/exchanges/:id/cancel |
| Notifications | GET /api/notifications, GET /api/notifications/unread-count, PATCH /api/notifications/read-all, PATCH /api/notifications/:id/read, DELETE /api/notifications/:id |
| Transactions | GET /api/transactions, GET /api/transactions/stats |

post.description:
### Create Purchase Request

**Endpoint:** `POST /api/purchases`

**Access:** 🔐 Authenticated — requires a valid Bearer token

Creates a new purchase request for a product listed by another user. The authenticated user becomes the initiator (buyer). The product must be `AVAILABLE` and owned by `targetUserId`. On success the product status is set to `RESERVED` and a notification is sent to the seller.

---

### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `targetUserId` | integer | ✅ | ID of the product owner (seller) |
| `productId` | integer | ✅ | ID of the product to purchase |
| `offeredPrice` | number | ✅ | Offered price (must be > 0) |
| `message` | string | ❌ | Optional message to the seller (max 500 chars) |

---

### Success Response — `201 Created`

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "statusCode": 201,
  "message": "Purchase request created successfully",
  "data": {
    "purchase_request_id": 1,
    "initiator_user_id": 2,
    "target_user_id": 3,
    "product_id": 5,
    "offered_price": 150.00,
    "buyer_message": "I'd like to buy this",
    "request_status": "PENDING",
    "requested_at": "2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z"
  },
  "timestamp": "2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z"
}
```

---

### Error Responses

| Status | Cause |
| --- | --- |
| `400 Bad Request` | Validation error or trying to buy own product |
| `401 Unauthorized` | Missing or invalid Bearer token |
| `409 Conflict` | Product not available or pending request already exists |

get.description:
### Get All Purchases

**Endpoint:** `GET /api/purchases`

**Access:** 🔐 Authenticated — requires a valid Bearer token

Returns a paginated list of purchase requests where the authenticated user is either the initiator (buyer) or the target (seller). Supports optional filtering by status.

---

### Query Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `page` | integer | ❌ | Page number (default: 1, min: 1) |
| `limit` | integer | ❌ | Items per page (default: 20, max: 100) |
| `status` | string | ❌ | Filter by status: `PENDING`, `ACCEPTED`, `REJECTED`, `COMPLETED`, `CANCELLED` |

---

### Success Response — `200 OK`

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "statusCode": 200,
  "message": "Purchase requests retrieved successfully",
  "data": {
    "requests": [
      {
        "purchase_request_id": 1,
        "initiator_user_id": 2,
        "target_user_id": 3,
        "product_id": 5,
        "offered_price": 150.00,
        "buyer_message": "I'd like to buy this",
        "request_status": "PENDING",
        "requested_at": "2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z"
      }
    ],
    "total": 1,
    "page": 1,
    "limit": 20
  },
  "timestamp": "2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z"
}
```

---

### Error Responses

| Status | Cause |
| --- | --- |
| `401 Unauthorized` | Missing or invalid Bearer token |

post.description:
### Create Exchange Request

**Endpoint:** `POST /api/exchanges`

**Access:** 🔐 Authenticated — requires a valid Bearer token

Creates a new product exchange request. The authenticated user becomes the initiator. Both `initiatorProductId` (your product) and `targetProductId` (the product you want) must be `AVAILABLE`. You cannot exchange with yourself.

---

### Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `targetUserId` | integer | ✅ | ID of the other user (product owner) |
| `initiatorProductId` | integer | ✅ | ID of your product to offer |
| `targetProductId` | integer | ✅ | ID of the product you want |
| `message` | string | ❌ | Optional message to the other user (max 500 chars) |

---

### Success Response — `201 Created`

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "statusCode": 201,
  "message": "Exchange request created successfully",
  "data": {
    "exchange_request_id": 1,
    "initiator_user_id": 2,
    "target_user_id": 3,
    "initiator_product_id": 4,
    "target_product_id": 5,
    "request_status": "PENDING",
    "requested_at": "2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z"
  },
  "timestamp": "2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z"
}
```

---

### Error Responses

| Status | Cause |
| --- | --- |
| `400 Bad Request` | Validation error or trying to exchange with yourself |
| `401 Unauthorized` | Missing or invalid Bearer token |
| `409 Conflict` | One of the products is not available or a pending request already exists |

### Get All Notifications

**Endpoint:** `GET /api/notifications`

**Access:** 🔐 Authenticated — requires a valid Bearer token

Returns all notifications (read and unread) for the authenticated user, ordered by most recent first. Supports optional pagination via `page` and `limit` query parameters.

---

### Query Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `page` | integer | ❌ | Page number (default: 1) |
| `limit` | integer | ❌ | Items per page (default: 20) |

---

### Success Response — `200 OK`

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "statusCode": 200,
  "message": "Notifications retrieved successfully",
  "data": {
    "notifications": [
      {
        "notification_id": 1,
        "user_id": 2,
        "notification_type": "PURCHASE_REQUEST",
        "message": "You have a new purchase offer",
        "is_read": false,
        "created_at": "2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z"
      }
    ],
    "total": 1,
    "page": 1,
    "limit": 20
  },

}
```

---

| Status | Cause |
| --- | --- |
| `401 Unauthorized` | Missing or invalid Bearer token |

get.description:
### Get All Transactions

**Endpoint:** `GET /api/transactions`

**Access:** 🔐 Authenticated — requires a valid Bearer token

Returns a combined, paginated list of all exchange and purchase requests for the authenticated user, sorted by most recent first. Each item includes a `type` field (`EXCHANGE` or `PURCHASE`) and a `status` field.

---

### Query Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `page` | integer | ❌ | Page number (default: 1) |
| `limit` | integer | ❌ | Items per page (default: 20) |
| `status` | string | ❌ | Filter by status: `PENDING`, `ACCEPTED`, `REJECTED`, `COMPLETED`, `CANCELLED` |

---

### Success Response — `200 OK`

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "statusCode": 200,
  "message": "Transactions retrieved successfully",
  "data": {
    "transactions": [
      {
        "type": "PURCHASE",
        "status": "PENDING",
        "created_at": "2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z"
      },
      {
        "type": "EXCHANGE",
        "status": "COMPLETED",
        "created_at": "2023-12-01T00:00:00.000Z"
      }
    ],
    "total": 2,
    "page": 1,
    "limit": 20
  },
  "timestamp": "2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z"
}
```

---

### Error Responses

| Status | Cause |
| --- | --- |
| `401 Unauthorized` | Missing or invalid Bearer token |
